Controls

Arrows move. X confirms or talks; Z cancels or runs. S opens the in-game menu. A changes the active character where supported. Q/W are L/R. Enter is Start; Shift is Select. Escape pauses.

Drag the movement stick in any of eight directions; release to stop. On the touch pad, A confirms, B cancels/runs, and X opens the in-game menu. A standard gamepad uses the matching SNES button positions; hold Start + Select to pause. In these browser menus, use the joystick or D-pad, the south button to select, and the east button to return. Left/right adjust selected settings.

In Cinderfall Commons, the road keeper returns you to the current chapter. Nearby guides reach homes, rest, trade and the seven training benches. Campfires restore HP/MP and let you change your travelling crew. At the Kiln, the route keeper opens earlier city regions. The merchant sells equipment and supplies; use the in-game menu to equip purchases. Returning to the Kiln renews ordinary enemies. Bosses, objectives and treasure stay cleared. A new chapter creates an automatic checkpoint after arrival settles, even when you continue directly along the road. Restore checkpoint retries from there. Returning to the title screen saves your current place. Save/Load keeps a separate manual save. Export saves for a backup.
